bullets.title: All-in-One Display for Offline Use
bullets.text: See crucial stats directly at your feet. Real-time progress without needing a phone keeps you motivated and focused on your health journey. Offline use is available once set up using the eufy Life App.

bullets.title: 3.36-Inch Easy-to-Read Large Screen
bullets.text: The 3.36-inch color TFT screen displays rich, informative data. Track health metrics and trends over time with intuitive, comprehensive dashboards.

bullets.title: High Accuracy
bullets.text: Our scale features an anti-tip base and four advanced sensors, ensuring precise weight measurements up to 0.1 lb (0.05 kg).

bullets.title: 16 Key Body Metrics on Display
bullets.text: Get immediate readings of weight, body fat, muscle mass, and more, clearly displayed on the scale for quick assessment.

bullets.title: Multiple Modes and Users
bullets.text: Features six modes: normal, simple, guest, baby/pet, and athlete. Supports unlimited users, perfect for families and fitness groups.

bullets.title: Note
bullets.text: The body fat scale only supports Bluetooth connectivity.

24632.name: Hard Floor Cleaning Solution For S1/E25 Series

bullets.title: Wide Compatibility
bullets.text: Compatible with eufy Omni S1 Pro/S1/E25, this hard floor cleaner effectively tackles various surfaces, including tiles, hard floors, and composite floors.

bullets.title: Gentle and Safe
bullets.text: Formulated with non-irritating ingredients, it's safe for homes with kids and pets.

bullets.title: Stain Removal
bullets.text: Say goodbye to stubborn stains and dirt.

bullets.title: Automatic Mixing
bullets.text: No more manual dilution! The cleaner automatically mixes when inserted into the base station.

bullets.title: Note
bullets.text: To protect your machine and extend its lifespan, buying our branded replacement parts is recommended, as we have received customer complaints from relevant non-compliant sellers.

bullets.title: IPX5 Water-Resistant
bullets.text: soundcore P25i true wireless earbuds are protected against water, so you can wear them during workouts and outdoors, whatever the weather.

bullets.title: Big 10mm Drivers
bullets.text: The drivers produce powerful sound with punchy bass.

bullets.title: 22 Preset EQs
bullets.text: Choose how you want to hear your music in the Soundcore app.

bullets.title: Ergonomic, Lightweight Fit
bullets.text: The small earbuds are lightweight and comfortable for long listening sessions. They fit in a tiny case with a lanyard that can be stored and carried conveniently.

bullets.title: All-Day Playtime
bullets.text: Get 10 hours of playtime on a single charge and stay powered for 30 hours in total with the case.

bullets.title: AI-Clear Calls
bullets.text: 2 mics and AI processing ensures that your voice is heard in crystal clear clarity.

bullets.title: Fast Charging
bullets.text: A fast 10-minute charge gives your earbuds an extra 2 hours of playtime.

bullets.title: IPX5 Water-Resistant
bullets.text: Soundcore P25i true wireless earbuds are protected from splashes of water, so you can wear them outside, even when it rains. *Note: Water resistance rating applies to earbuds, not the charging case.

bullets.title: Instant Pairing
bullets.text: During first use, open the charging case, take Soundcore P25i true wireless earbuds out and they will enter pairing mode. From then on, the earbuds will connect to the last paired device every time you use them.

bullets.title: Single Earbud Mode
bullets.text: Leave one ear free to hear your surroundings while you listen to audio with the other. A solo earbud can play audio, while the other is in the case.

bullets.title: Hi-Res Audio, Rich Bass
bullets.text: Enjoy Hi-Res sound and rich bass with in-ear-level quality. Our advanced virtual bass technology enriches the lows, complemented by a 12mm titanium-coated driver for clear listening. Note: Update the soundcore app to the latest version for the best listening experience.

bullets.title: Adaptive Ultra-Comfort
bullets.text: Designed to relieve in-ear discomfort, soundcore AeroClip open-ear clip-on earbuds let you enjoy music pressure-free for every outdoor venture.

bullets.title: Flexible, Secure Fit
bullets.text: soundcore AeroClip clip-on earbuds boast an adaptive open-ring design that endures 20,000 bends. Feather-light and flexible, they stay secure for all-day wear.

bullets.title: AI-Boosted Clear Calls
bullets.text: With 4 beamforming mics, wind-blocking meshes, and advanced AI, experience flawless calls, even in the busiest street.

bullets.title: Effortlessly Chic
bullets.text: Your style, your vibe. In three vibrant looks, these open-ear clip-on earbuds deliver incredible audio with a touch of flair.

bullets.title: AI-Driven Party Speaker
bullets.text: Feel powerful sound fill every corner, while dynamic lights bring the dance floor to life. With dual pro mics and AI vocal removal, singing your favorite songs has never been easier.

bullets.title: 200W Powerful Sound
bullets.text: Enjoy booming 200W sound and deep bass via a 6.5″ woofer and three 2.5″ full-range drivers. This party speaker is loud enough to fill a basketball court, delivering the ultimate party atmosphere for any occasion.

bullets.title: Immersive Beat-Synced Light Show
bullets.text: Transform your home or backyard into a vibrant party space, and customize the light effects to set the perfect mood and match any vibe.

bullets.title: Dual Wireless Microphones
bullets.text: Own every duet with crystal-clear vocals and built-in volume and vocal removal controls.

bullets.title: AI Vocal Removal
bullets.text: Turn any gathering into a karaoke party with one click. Choose any song from any app, and AI removes the original vocals in real time. Adjust vocal levels to sing along or go full solo — your voice, your stage!

bullets.title: App Customization
bullets.text: The soundcore app gives you full control over your party speaker. Easily adjust EQ settings, lighting, vocal effects, and reverb.

bullets.title: Quick Power Boost
bullets.text: Harness the speed of Samsung Super Fast Charging for all Samsung devices, powered by advanced GaN technology — perfect for quick energy boosts.

bullets.title: Designed for Efficiency and Safety
bullets.text: Delivers rapid charging with ActiveShield technology to prevent overheating, complemented by comprehensive safety features that protect against electrical leakage.

bullets.title: Ultra-Portable and Sleek
bullets.text: This pocket-sized charger features a foldable plug for easy storage and is exceptionally lightweight. It combines convenience with style, making it the perfect companion for on-the-go charging.

bullets.title: Universal Charging
bullets.text: Supports a wide range of devices from Samsung to Apple, providing a reliable power source for all your charging needs.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Nano Charger (45W), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

24845.name: X1 | 4K Triple Laser Projector with Micro Gimbal

bullets.title: Exceptional Brightness and Stunning 4K Clarity
bullets.text: Features a patented triple-laser optical engine to deliver 3,500 ANSI lumens and 110% Rec. 2020 color. Certified by ISF and TUV and supports Dolby Vision.

bullets.title: See Every Shade of Darkness with Ultra-High Contrast
bullets.text: A 6-blade iris delivers a native contrast ratio of 5,000:1, enhanced by NebulaMaster technology to reach an impressive 56,000:1.

bullets.title: 0.9-1.5 Short to Long Throw Motorized Optical Zoom
bullets.text: Easily adjust the image size to fit any space without moving the projector while preserving the original image quality.

bullets.title: Proprietary Innovations
bullets.text: Built-in with a 14-element all-glass lens for cinema-grade clarity, a motorized 25° micro gimbal that adapts to 10 ft high walls, and a liquid cooling system that improves heat dissipation and lowers noise to under 26 dB.

bullets.title: Perfect Viewing with AI Spatial Adaptation
bullets.text: Scans your projection surface and adjusts the image to the best position, size, and clarity in just one click. Spatial Recall saves and restores your preferences for each space.

bullets.title: Watch Official Netflix in 4K
bullets.text: Enjoy 10,000+ apps, including official 4K Netflix with Dolby Vision via Google TV — no sideloading or dongles required.

24967.name: Laptop Charger (140W, 4-Port, PD 3.1) with USB-C Cable

bullets.title: Fast Charging for Four Devices
bullets.text: Enjoy the convenience of powering four devices simultaneously with our advanced GaN technology for optimal performance.

bullets.title: Dual High-Speed USB-C Ports
bullets.text: Rapidly charge your 15-inch MacBook Air to 50% in just 30 minutes with either of the two USB-C ports, each offering a maximum output of 140W.

bullets.title: Superior Safety
bullets.text: The advanced ActiveShield 2.0 system monitors device temperatures over 3 million times a day for enhanced safety.

bullets.title: Monitor with Ease and Clarity
bullets.text: The high-definition color display provides a detailed view of the charging status, temperature, and port details, keeping you fully informed.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Charger (140W, 4-Port, PD 3.1), 5 ft 240W USB-C to USB-C cable, user manual, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Sleek Design
bullets.text: The Anker Magnetic Car Stand boasts a sleek and modern design in a stylish silver color, enhancing the aesthetics of your car interior.

bullets.title: Magnetic Mounting
bullets.text: Equipped with strong magnets, this car stand securely holds your device in place, providing a reliable and stable mounting solution for your phone.

bullets.title: 360-Degree Rotation
bullets.text: Enjoy the flexibility of a 360-degree rotating mechanism, allowing you to adjust the viewing angle for optimal visibility and convenience.

bullets.title: Secure Attachment
bullets.text: The stand features a secure attachment mechanism that ensures your device stays firmly in place even during bumpy rides or sudden stops.

bullets.title: Universal Compatibility
bullets.text: Designed to accommodate a wide range of smartphones, the Anker Magnetic Car Stand is universally compatible, making it suitable for various devices.

bullets.title: Easy Installation
bullets.text: The stand is easy to install in your car, providing a hassle-free setup to keep your phone accessible while driving.

bullets.title: Quality Materials
bullets.text: Crafted with high-quality materials, the Anker Magnetic Car Stand is durable and built to withstand daily use, providing long-lasting reliability.

bullets.title: Compact and Portable
bullets.text: Despite its sturdy construction, the car stand is compact and portable, allowing you to easily move it between vehicles or store it when not in use.

bullets.title: 2x Stronger Voice Reduction
bullets.text: The ANC 3.0 technology and a purpose-built acoustic cavity target, dampen, and block human voices 2x more effectively. It lets you enjoy a quiet journey on trains and subways.

bullets.title: Real-Time Adaptive Noise Cancellation
bullets.text: The Adaptive ANC 3.0 algorithm adjusts every 0.3 seconds to accommodate every subtle shift in your environment for optimal, seamless silence around the clock.

bullets.title: Immersive Dolby Audio
bullets.text: With industry-leading Dolby Audio and custom modes for music, movies, and podcasts, Liberty 5 wireless earbuds put you in the front seat of any performance.

bullets.title: Balanced, Detail-Rich Listening
bullets.text: Powered by wool paper diaphragms, bass-enhancing tubes, LDAC, and Hi-Res Audio, these noise-cancelling earbuds reproduce musical nuances, delivering rich, well-balanced treble and bass.

bullets.title: 6-Mic AI Calls
bullets.text: Equipped with six mics, AI noise cancellation, and a wind-resistant algorithm, these wireless earbuds capture your voice and reduce wind noise, ensuring natural, clear calls as if you're talking face to face.

bullets.title: Charges Fast, Lasts Long
bullets.text: Up to 12 hours of playback on a single charge and up to 48 hours with the case in normal mode. With ANC on, get 8 hours per charge and a total of 32 hours. A quick 10-minute charge gives you 5 hours of playtime.

25203.name: MagGo Wireless Charging Station (3-in-1, Dock Stand)

bullets.title: Ultra-Fast 15W Wireless Charging
bullets.text: Harness full 15W charging power, giving your essential devices the quickest charge, consistent with the original MagSafe technology.

bullets.title: Compact Charging for 3 Devices
bullets.text: Ideal for clutter-free workspaces, this compact charger fits ideally on any desk, powering everything from phones to watches.

bullets.title: Certified Fast Charging for Apple Watch
bullets.text: Boasts official certification, enabling you to power your Apple Watch Series 10 from 0 to 100% in just 1 hour and 13 minutes. (Note: Data based on internal lab testing; actual charging times may vary.)

bullets.title: Set Your Preferred Angle
bullets.text: Adjust vertically up to 45 degrees to find your optimal charging view and enjoy StandBy mode in landscape orientation.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker MagGo Wireless Charging Station (3-in-1, Dock Stand), 40W USB-C adapter, 5 ft USB-C to USB-C cable, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Leave the Ice Behind
bullets.text: No more watery messes or lost space from ice. Keep drinks frozen and food chilled from -4°F to 68°F.

bullets.title: Dual-Zone Cooling
bullets.text: Put drinks and meat in their own compartments for independent cooling and freezing.

bullets.title: Even and Fast Frost Flow Cooling
bullets.text: In just 15 minutes, drop from 77°F to 32°F, with food and beverages evenly cooled, no more warm surprises.

bullets.title: Everlasting Chill at 39°F
bullets.text: Keep adventures cool for 4.3 days with two 288Wh batteries (52 hr with one 288Wh battery).

bullets.title: 4 Ways to Recharge
bullets.text: Recharge in any situation. Use a 100W solar panel, car socket, wall outlet, or USB-C cord.

bullets.title: 3 Ways to Chill
bullets.text: Cool down fast in Max mode, extend battery life in Eco mode, or optimize both in Smart mode.

bullets.title: What's in the Box
bullets.text: Anker SOLIX EverFrost 2 Cooler, Removable Battery, AC Adapter and Charging Cable, Car Charging Cable, Accessory Container, Wheel Chock, Safety, and Quick Start Guide.
